draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 124th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 17th of 35 at WR. He went 91st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (124th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Jacoby Ford. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (99th percentile). College production: 636 receiving yards in 2020, 19th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: inactive. Last NFL action came in 2022. 25 career games and 3 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: receiving yards 51 (11th percentile), receiving td 0 (13th percentile). Played 11 of 17 games in 2022.
